title: The Foundations of a Russian Dictatorship: The Kremlin’s New Ideology
gist: Andrey Pertsev argues that Sergei Kiriyenko's Kremlin team has assembled a quasi-ideology combining a 'civilizational code' (sacralized power, collectivism, self-sacrifice) with a 'technocratic dictatorship' model that excludes society from decisionmaking. He contends the technocratic core is a portable template that any post-Putin successor could adopt, while the indoctrination machinery already reaches millions of students and is spreading into state corporations.

insights.claim: Five years into the full-scale war on Ukraine, the Putin regime has for the first time acquired something approaching an ideological foundation, formulated by First Deputy Chief of Staff Sergei Kiriyenko's domestic policy team.
